_what: What a child says on their first turn when something is already built. Written against the seven distinct board states rather than the fourteen chapters, because parts and ports collapse to seven and the fixture should test the ceiling rather than pretend it isn't there.
_voice: The same child as the fourteen openers and as transcript-64b1660d — plain, lowercase, describing objects rather than naming them. A child in a library has not read the earlier chapters and has no vocabulary for what the last child built.
_constraint: None may satisfy matched(). A child describing a half-built board is not reporting a fault, and BM says so. Run check_opener.py on each.
